scope: One final recovery candidate, one frozen first-block acceptance; no second tuning round. Preserve effective_response_refined production and retained real state_v2. Then hand off feature outputs to response-factor analysis within B1, not future-capacity algorithm2.
candidate: Retain current real-event verifier/onset. Replace only recovery verifier with one standard LogisticRegression C1 at the existing .7 threshold. Four fixed features: previous two fractions of already observed excursion, plus log1p absolute power/current distance to preceding observed state divided by descriptive floors. Distinguishes percentage return from actual closeness for slow recovery. Same235 training positions and user-group4fold conditional OOF, no new labels or hyperparameter grid.
training_choice: Use only original96 training windows and existing training labels. Compare to frozen prior recovery-head OOF at.7; candidate eligible only if recovery interval error drops at least1percent, endpoint error nonincreases, missing/spurious return/FP/FN nonincrease. Otherwise freeze retained state_v2. No validation-result tuning.
freeze_before_test: Freeze all inference sources/models, candidate decision, sample/label/scoring rules and budget before reading any final-test observations. One test evaluation for this closing stage. External Office test remains sealed. No retraining or reannotation against results.
real_final_sample: 48 windows:12 each short_limit,small_step,ordinary_step,quiet_limit, selected from canonical test only using timestamps,pilot and source-path hashes, users spread before duplicate windows, one nonoverlapping240s window per source session. No selection using power/current/model outputs. No response-quality exclusions. If a stratum has fewer12 candidates, retain available and record shortage; never replace by response-based selection.
real_labels: After model freeze and selection, view raw power/current/pilot only, before any model output. Single-assistant provisional visible-change,onset and recovery neighboring native brackets; unknown/NA retained, not negative; no fault/causal/effective physical duration truth invented. Freeze labels before original CPOP/LABS and adapted inference. Original pilot is current limit, not execution ACK. Native times are not interpolated or stretched.
real_comparison: Same raw observations and original CPOP/LABS settings as prior pilot, index-based fits mapped to actual seconds. Compare originalCPOP,LABS,retained-state_v2 and one closing candidate only if training eligible. No class filtering to detected successes. Timing interval/endpoint errors capped180s; missing180s. Include observed onset-to-return span with its explicit nonphysical definition, detection counts,censored false returns and short observed-change misses.
candidate_acceptance: On the one final test, at least5percent less recovery interval MAE than retained; endpoint and observed-span MAE nonincrease; no extra missing return,censored false return,false positive,false negative,or observed short-change misses. If ineligible/failed/no recovery references, keep retained. Never follow final-test failure with another candidate or threshold adjustment.
known_reference_acceptance: Separately generate one fresh frozen simulated known-reference panel using existing generator, minute and10s, seeds8813000 and8813001, per_kind1, including null,weak/short/gap/ramp and Gaussian/spike/persistent anomalies. Same native curves for CPOP/LABS and unchanged production effective_response_refined. Check onset,cumulative/longest effective duration,power-recovery,raw energy and delivery ratio. Evaluate missing feature estimates as failures, not dropped successes. Full durations use.15kW/30s existing definitions; original raw observed energy stays raw, clean-latent energy used only to score metering noise. Do not reuse real observed span as physical C/L.
closure: Freeze retained beneficial production even if remaining defects or candidate rejection. Record scope-limited acceptance and unresolved errors explicitly. Produce all-event feature handoff with sources/status, including nonresponders; do not select only qualified positive events for factor analysis. Real ACN lacks offered-incentive/pretreatment-deadline truth, so no causal compensation effect claim from these data.
methods_source: Reuse existing scikit-learn1.7.2 standard LogisticRegression/StandardScaler/GroupKFold, maintained BSD-3-Clause https://github.com/scikit-learn/scikit-learn ; exact prior originalCPOP1.0.10 and frozen MIT LABS. No new library/model family/dependency install.
limits: No reports,reference forecasting,point deletion,gap filling,old artifact rewrite,GPU,commit,upload or production default change. Existing labels remain provisional; this final test is stage-held-out data, not independent human physical gold. No promise of95percent accuracy. No reopening this stage to chase its test.
